summary: Frontend-only verification of the TDZ blank-page fix and 4 UI features on the prebuilt static bundle. Independently crawled every sidebar item for admin (52), manager (44) and finance (14) with pageerror listeners: ZERO blank pages, ZERO pageerrors, ZERO console errors. Verified: (1) nav-products-pricing renders (Produk Master table + all 8 hub tabs incl. Kategori & Pricelist per-PT) with no 'Cannot access before initialization'; (2) Pembelian → Pesanan Pembelian all 5 hub tabs render incl. previously circular-import 'Blanket / Kontrak' and 'Order Makloon'; (3) SO compact panel (so-compact-panel) shows stage pill, pelanggan, qty pesan, grand total, payment; so-open-full-detail opens so-detail-popup with full OrderDetailPanel; Confirm action inside popup succeeded (SO-0007 Disetujui → Terkonfirmasi, list KPI Dipesan 3→2), Esc and so-detail-popup-close both close the popup and keep the compact panel; (4) SO list order-qty-{id}/order-date-{id} (9 each) and PO list po-qty-{id} (qty + 'terima N (x%)') / date / po-total-{id} (12 each) render without overlap; (5) manager Pusat Persetujuan decision popup decision-queue-pos shows '1 dari 5' matching the 'Semua 5' filtered tab, and after Setujui it advances to the next doc with '1 dari 4' plus a guiding toast. Regressions OK: Beranda admin, Meja Finance, POS 'Semua Filter' modal, Retur detail (Draf→Persetujuan→Inspeksi 4-Titik→Penyelesaian stepper + eligibility/nota kredit).

issues: Large empty ~300px left column (detail/placeholder panel renders nothing, not even an empty-state), pushing the Records card to the right and leaving a big white gap

design_issues.screen: Retur & Barang Sisa → detail SRET-00003 'ITEM YANG DIRETUR' table
issues: Unit duplicated: '10 yard' followed by another 'yard' in the Sat. column
'Alasan' text (Warna tidak sesuai contoh) is clipped/visually collides with the Harga column
Row baselines misaligned (product name sits lower than qty/kondisi cells)

design_issues.screen: Daftar Pesanan (SO list) vs SO detail
issues: Column header 'TOTAL' shows order.total_amount (pre-PPN, e.g. Rp 4.375.000) while compact panel/detail show Grand Total incl. PPN (Rp 4.856.250) — same document appears with two different amounts; consider labelling the column 'Subtotal' or using grand_total

Label reads 'PPN 12%' but the amount is 11% of subtotal (15.700.000 → 1.727.000). Frontend renders sel.ppn_rate as-is, so the mismatch comes from the order data (ppn_rate=12 stored with an 11% amount) — data/seed inconsistency, cosmetic but confusing

action_items: Fill or hide the empty left column on the 'Produk (Master)' hub tab (render an empty-state or make the table full width)
Fix Retur detail item table: remove duplicated unit, give the Alasan column its own width so it stops colliding with Harga, align row baselines
Align SO list 'TOTAL' column with the detail Grand Total (rename to Subtotal or show grand_total)
Investigate order ppn_rate=12 stored against an 11% ppn_amount (data/seed) so 'PPN 12%' label matches the number
critical_code_review_comments: AdminView.jsx visibleRecords useMemo is now correctly declared after `records`; no remaining TDZ pattern found on the crawled routes.

OrdersView.jsx renders both SOCompactPanel and the full OrderDetailPanel inside DetailPopup; the OrderDetailPanel keeps its own internal close (XCircle) button inside the popup in addition to so-detail-popup-close — two visually different closes in one modal is redundant UX (both work).
SO list total uses order.total_amount while SOCompactPanel uses grand_total — pick one source for the money column to avoid mismatched figures.
seed_data_creation: No new records created. Test actions mutated demo data: SO-0007 confirmed (Disetujui → Terkonfirmasi) and stock-opname approval 'Opname Bandung — Spot Check' approved by manager (pending queue 21 → 20). Restore with `python seed_realistic.py` + `python seed_e9_chain_demo.py` if a pristine demo state is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static bundle: never run yarn start; after src edits run `bash /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh`. Sidebar nav ids: penjualan group → nav-sales-orders (NOT nav-orders), nav-products-pricing, nav-pos; pembelian group → nav-purchase-orders. Hub tabs: hub-tab-orders (then click text 'Daftar Pesanan' for the list sub-tab), hub-tab-purchasing, hub-tab-blanket-po, hub-tab-makloon-orders. Approval decision modal testids: decision-modal-approve/reject/close/open-full, decision-queue-pos. SO popup: so-compact-panel, so-open-full-detail, so-detail-popup, so-detail-popup-close; SO actions inside popup: confirm-order-button-{id}, release-reservation-button-{id}, cancel-order-button-{id}. Crawler /app/scripts/crawl_blank.py <email> prints blank/error pages per role (~2-4 min per role) — all three roles clean in this iteration. Remaining open items are cosmetic (see design_issues).
rca_of_the_issue: Original blank pages were a TDZ ReferenceError (visibleRecords useMemo referencing `records` before initialization) plus two circular imports. Re-verified after the fix: no pageerror events on any of the 110 crawled route/tab combinations across three roles, so the fix holds.
